title: ALL () with no arguments removes every filter of the filter context
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALL () ) ), 'Product'[Color] = "Red", 'Date'[Year] = 2024 )

source.quote: ALL without arguments can be used only as a CALCULATE or CALCULATETABLE modifier and removes all the filters from the filter context.
source.supports: ALL without arguments removes all the filters from the filter context
the page's last example has this shape (two outer filters, CALCULATE with ALL ()) and shows the grand total

derivation: Outer filters Color = Red and Year = 2024 give 300. ALL () removes both: 540.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
